_introText.text: The gateway is controlled locally via the Tuya LAN protocol. Device ID and local key can be read from the debug log of the MiBoxer app (see README).

deviceId.label: Device ID
deviceId.help: Tuya device ID of the WL-433 gateway

localKey.label: Local key
localKey.help: 16 characters, changes whenever the gateway is paired again

ip.label: IP address of the gateway
ip.help: Leave empty to find the gateway automatically in the local network

_discover.label: Search gateway in the local network

result.found: Gateway found at %s (protocol %s). IP address and protocol version have been entered, please save the settings.
result.list: Tuya devices in the local network: %s

error.noneFound: No Tuya device announced itself in the local network. Is the gateway online and in the same network segment as ioBroker?
error.notFoundOthers: Gateway %s was not found. Other Tuya devices: %s

_discoverHint.text: The search needs a running adapter instance and takes up to 12 seconds. Without a device ID all Tuya devices found are listed.

reconnectInterval.label: Reconnect delay
reconnectInterval.help: Seconds until a lost or failed connection is retried

pollInterval.label: Status refresh interval
pollInterval.help: Seconds between full status requests, 0 = only use the updates pushed by the gateway

_singleConnectionHint.text: Tuya devices usually accept only one local connection. If the connection keeps failing, close the MiBoxer app on phones in the same network and do not control the gateway with other local integrations at the same time.

zoneMode.label: Zone control
zoneMode.help: How the 8 zones of the gateway are offered in ioBroker

_zoneModeSelectorText.text: light.* shows the status reported by the gateway. The state light.zone selects the zone the commands of light.* are sent to (0 = all zones, 1–8 = one zone). Recommended, because every state shows what the gateway reports.

_zoneModeChannelsText.text: light.* shows the status reported by the gateway and sends its commands to all zones. In addition, the channels zones.zone1 … zones.zone8 control each zone separately. The gateway does not report a status per zone: a zone channel shows the last values sent to this zone and confirmed by the gateway.

_zoneModeHint.text: The gateway reports only one status for all lamps: the last setting, whichever zone it was sent to. When this setting is changed, the states of the other variant are deleted.
